name: Switchroom emergency door-release interface
aliases: switchrooms Switchroom lighting and access interfaces
summary: Shows the assigned release signal between the emergency system and access-control equipment.
description: Shows the assigned release signal between the emergency system and access-control equipment. Lighting and access interfaces coordinate the electrical-room service circuits and their supervision. Normal lighting, emergency illumination and access indication have different power sources and purposes.

In a switchroom, a normal lighting branch may be switched locally while the specified emergency luminaires remain connected to their own backed-up or integral supply. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Approved emergency release output” at the input and “Access system release input” at the output. The block does not specify an egress compliance solution.
